name: io.github.open-mcp-ai/termcp
description: An MCP server that lets AI agents act like a human at a real terminal, local or over SSH.

environmentVariables.name: TERMCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token that guards the MCP/HTTP surface. Required here because the container's default command binds 0.0.0.0, and termcp refuses a non-loopback bind without a credential (use a long random secret). Clients then send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
